title: Why do we need to sleep?
examples: Why is sleep important for my body?
What happens to my brain when I sleep?
Do I need to sleep the same amount every night?

explain.say: When you sleep, your body does important work.

draw.text: Why do we need to sleep?

explain.say: Sleep helps your body grow bigger and stronger every day.
Sleep helps your brain keep all the things you learn.
Sleep is a time when your body gets a chance to rest.
When we sleep, our bodies and brains get ready for the next day.
If you do not sleep enough, you might feel grumpy and tired.

faq.q: Do I have to sleep the same amount every night?
faq.a: It is good to try and keep a regular sleep time. Your body likes routine to know when to rest.
asks: Should my sleep time be the same?

faq.q: Can I catch up on sleep on the weekend?
faq.a: A little extra sleep is nice, but it is better to keep a steady routine. Big changes can confuse your body clock.
asks: Can I sleep in a lot?

faq.q: Does my brain actually clean itself while I sleep?
faq.a: Yes, scientists think your brain cleans up waste from the day. This helps it work well when you wake up.
asks: What does my brain do at night?

faq.q: Is getting enough sleep only for little kids?
faq.a: No, all people need good sleep, even grown-ups. Everyone needs time to rest and recharge their bodies.

faq.q: What happens if I sleep too much?
faq.a: Sleeping too much can sometimes mean you are not getting enough activity during the day. Talk to a grown-up if this happens often.
asks: Should I wake up if I sleep too long?

facts: Sleep helps your body repair itself after a long day.
During sleep, your brain sorts and stores memories from the day.
Getting enough rest helps you feel awake and focused when you are learning.
Your body needs sleep to keep all your systems working smoothly.

quiz.say: What is one thing your body does while you sleep?
quiz.why: The body uses sleep time to fix itself, like rebuilding toys.

wrong.1: Running fast needs energy you save for the day.
wrong.2: Eating food gives you energy when you are awake.
wrong.3: Playing games needs your eyes and hands to work.

quiz.say: If you do not sleep enough, what might happen to your focus?
quiz.why: Lack of sleep makes it hard for your brain to concentrate.

wrong.0: Tiredness usually makes you feel sleepy, not energetic.
wrong.2: Being tired makes your brain slow, not stronger.
wrong.3: Tiredness makes it harder to take in new information.

quiz.say: When you sleep, your brain is busy doing what?
quiz.why: Sleep time is when your brain files away everything you learned.

wrong.1: Cartoon watching happens when you are awake.
wrong.2: Playing outside needs your body to move around.
wrong.3: Eating a meal happens when you are awake.
